`okay_nabu.pcm` is the PCM of OHF-Voice/voice-incubator's
`tests/okay_nabu_turn_on_the_lights.wav` (Apache-2.0; 3 s, 16 kHz, 16-bit
mono, the 44-byte WAV header removed), the recording the mixednet stack's
on-Echo parity was run on (docs/history/device.md, 2026-11-17). `wake_test.go`
runs it through the satellite with `../../mixednet/testdata/okay_nabu.blob`.
